promptTemplate: Create one square close-cropped travel illustration for {{city}}. Depict ONLY this named journey subject: {{motif}}. Make a specific detail of that subject fill most of the frame, with just a hint of its real surroundings. Use an eye-level viewpoint, tactile gouache and colored-pencil marks, a restrained palette, and light matching the subject. This is a detail study, not a wide skyline or panoramic establishing view. Never add a dish, food, drink, souvenir, person, vehicle, animal, or landmark unless it is explicitly named in the subject. The application places this illustration into a separate postcard paper template, so the artwork fills the image edge to edge. Do not depict paper, postcard, stamp, handwriting, envelope, border, caption, readable text, numerals, logo, watermark, collage, or a second picture.
